unlisted_practices: Involve ethicists, nurses, and a wide range of society members in deciding whether robotic or AI-based nursing care should be introduced.
Conduct empirical research on patients' attitudes toward robots and AI in care before their widespread introduction.
Carefully monitor the quality and validity of algorithms that decode patients' facial expressions, including for patients who have lost the ability to speak.
Conduct further research on whether nurse-robot trust relationships form in actual clinical settings and how they affect nurse performance.
Conduct further research on what robot and AI appearance best supports cooperation with medical personnel.

screen.reason: Conceptual and ethical analysis discussing the possibilities and ethical concerns of delegating nursing tasks to AI and robotic systems.
